message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crimes based on facts. The case involves three sets:

1. Violence: Wang1 and others (including defendant Wang4) entered house with knife, gun, beat victim, causing heavy injury (right leg heavy injury, head light injury). That's intentional injury (故意伤害) causing heavy injury (重伤二级). So crime: 故意伤害 (maybe with weapons). Could be "故意伤害罪".

2. Property damage: Wang1 organized group to smash a car with axe, causing damage 5390 yuan. That's "故意毁坏财物罪" (deliberate destruction of property). Could be "毁坏财物罪".

3. Robbery: Wang1 organized group, took victim to remote area, threatened with cutting tendons, demanded cash 10k, got 2k transferred, plus a note. That's robbery (抢劫罪). So crimes: 故意伤害; 破坏财物 (毁坏财物); 抢劫.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害;毁坏财物;抢劫<eoa>
